/** Return a typed custom-property reference, accepting a suffix or a full contract name. */
export function cssVar(name) {
    const suffix = name.startsWith('--pm-') ? name.slice(5) : name;
    if (!Object.hasOwn(tokens.light, suffix))
        throw new TypeError('Unknown pm token');
    return `var(--pm-${suffix})`;
}
